description.value: Garry Point Grill and Fish & Chips is a casual seafood counter in the heart of historic Steveston Village, steps from Garry Point Park and the Fraser River waterfront — a natural pause point on Richmond's popular cycling routes. The menu centres on hand-battered fish and chips made with locally caught wild cod, salmon, and halibut, alongside burgers and a dedicated vegan section. Outdoor seating and a relaxed neighbourhood feel make it a welcoming rest stop for cyclists exploring the Steveston area.
